PoleImport.title: Import poles
PoleImport.description: Register many poles at once from a spreadsheet. Every pole gets its QR code automatically.

steps.title: Upload a CSV file
steps.description: Large files are checked first and then saved in batches of {max}.
steps.one: Download the template and fill one row per pole. Latitude and longitude are required; take them from a GPS survey or the existing asset register.
steps.two: In Excel or Google Sheets, save the sheet as "CSV UTF-8".
steps.three: Choose the file, check the summary and import. Nothing is saved if any row has a problem.
